## B — Licensing and required documents
Audience: first-time Montana non-commercial Class D applicants studying licensing and required documents.
Level: introductory rule retrieval; the ordered handbook section is the coverage basis, without any invented official examination weight. Prerequisites and confusable topics: Separate the ordinary document path from REAL ID, and the course permit from the general learner permit.
This is a research handoff. Commercial and motorcycle paragraphs, identification-card term lengths, historical REAL ID enforcement timing, fees and inconsistent license-duration statements are excluded from stable knowledge and explicitly retained as verification debt. Page seventeen contributes only REAL ID document content here; GDL content belongs in the next section.
